changelog:
cross-asset-contagion 1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Provides real-time cross-asset contagion risk scoring from APEX Runner’s live trading system.
- Enables early detection of systemic spillover risk across equities and commodities.
- Integrates seamless one-click access and payment via x402 protocol—no account or API key needed, just an EVM wallet.
- Offers tiered usage discounts for early adopters and frequent users.
summary: Cross-asset contagion risk score — detects systemic spillover risk
